title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reading.body:
This incident shows a general-purpose AI system being used to obtain information relevant to planning a violent crime, specifically legal consequences. The failure is not a model hallucination or false output, but a deployment without safeguards that refuse or flag queries about planning serious violence. The model answered a factual question that a person then used in preparing an attack.

The interaction happened at the user-input stage, before any human review or escalation. Catching it would have required content moderation that detects queries about legal penalties for violent acts, or a policy that blocks such planning assistance. The reports describe allegations by a prosecutor and an ongoing criminal case; no court has established that the model's responses caused or enabled the attack.

Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On October 1, 2024, a 23-year-old Chinese university student attacked three five-year-old boys with a knife at a daycare center in Zurich-Oerlikon, inflicting severe injuries. One child suffered a completely severed jugular vein and required emergency surgery to prevent death by blood loss or air embolism. A second boy was stabbed twice in the chest, damaging his heart sac and major blood vessels, and survived only due to immediate medical intervention. The third child sustained injuries to his ear and lung. A daycare worker stopped the attacker by grabbing his arms, allowing him to be restrained by bystanders until police arrived. The prosecutor alleges the man meticulously planned the attack using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and purchased raw beef to practice knife techniques.

The suspect faces attempted murder charges and has been described as acting with extraordinary cold-bloodedness motivated by resentment, vanity, and ideological delusion. Investigators documented that he researched where to find children in Zurich, studied human anatomy and blood vessels, and timed the attack for October 1, China's National Day. The prosecution seeks 15 years imprisonment plus a 15-year ban from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
